text:
Football Italia Live Blog
Join us for all the build-up and action as it happens from the Europa League and Conference League with Milan vs. Ferencvaros, Juventus away to AZ Alkmaar, and Atalanta in crisis against Kairat Almaty.
We begin at 17.45 GMT (18.45 CET) with two games, as Milan try to build on their Derby della Madonnina success and get back on track in Europe with Ferencvaros.
Atalanta have just two draws in five competitive matches, so cannot slip up against Kairat Almaty.
At 20.00 GMT (21.00 CET), Juventus take a trip to AZ Alkmaar and aim to keep strong Europa League form going, as the Koopmeiners brothers face off.
- All
- Favourites 0
Kelly robbed at the touchline by Oufkir, it doesn’t look like it rolled out of play, sent down the right for Dijkstra, who pulled back for the Meerdink tap-in!
Douglas Luiz on for Kolo Muani, Juventus hanging on now.
Bremer important block at the near post on a taut cross-shot.
Ekhator is booked for clattering into the back of Dijkstra.
AZ swarming now, Daal effort deflected over for a corner, you can see how Smit’s introduction inspired them.
Peer Koopmeiners free kick straight into the wall. Had to be delayed over some handbags between Bremer and the AZ players.
AZ want a penalty, Kelly has a hand on the shoulder of Dijkstra, but he is already turning in that direction and goes down through sheer momentum. Not a penalty.
Ekhator and Bremer on, Woltemade and Gatti off.
Kalulu low cross from the right is heading towards Woltemade, but intercepted from six yards!
That’s a real chance! Smit controls the roll across from 12 yards and fires over the bar!
Stengs off, Oufkir on for the final AZ Alkmaar substitution.
Koopmeiners gathers from Kolo Muani and his attempt gets a bit stuck under his feet, as well as charged down by Dijkstra.
It feels like Juventus weathered that storm of AZ pressure.
Gatti reads the Daal through ball for Meerdink and intercepts, he’s had a great game in the Juventus defence.
Smit strike from the edge of the area charged down by Kelly, AZ are definitely pushing now and Juve stuck in their own half.
Clasie strike is charged down, perhaps by a teammate, it was a bit of a scramble from the AZ players.
Woltemade through ball sends Gatti into the box down the right, denied by a desperate tackle!
Does Gatti know he’s a defender?
Goes, Kasius and Byskov off, AZ Alkmaar bring on Clasie, Dijkstra and Smit.
Now, Kees Smit has been out since September 20 and is their biggest danger upfront, so this is a big introduction.
Cabal and Boga on for Juventus, replacing Cambiaso and Alajbegovic.
Another wasted opportunity, this time Koopmeiners over-hits the pass for Alajbegovic!
Juve are swarming here, Gatti gets down the right, rolls it across and AZ put it out for a corner before Alajbegovic can pounce from six yards.
Gatti surges forward on the counter, it’s three on three, but the pass for Kolo Muani was not the right one…
Teun Koopmeiners pounces on a wayward goalkeeping pass out from the back under pressure from Woltemade, but he lays it off for Alajbegovic, who hesitates and the chance goes to waste!
Goes with the header at the back post, but it’s off target.
Daal on the counter, his shot from the edge of the box is deflected for a corner.
Cambiaso and Kasius get into a strange tangle on the touchline, the Juve man was booked. They were wrestling each other frankly, nobody was sure what happened.
No further changes.
Randal Kolo Muani adds a goal to go with his assist, all in less than 20 minutes 😮💨
